title: TypeScript Function Schema
description: A schema to capture all relevant information about TypeScript functions for RAG training and fine-tuning LLMs.

signature.description: The function's signature, including parameters and return type.

brief.description: A brief overview of the function's purpose.

detailed.description: A detailed explanation of the function's logic, including types and behaviors of parameters and returns.

type.description: All possible/allowed types for each parameter.

default.description: The default value of the parameter, if any.

description.description: Implications and variations in logic based on parameter type or value.

optional.description: Indicates if the parameter is optional.

tags.description: Tags for classifying or identifying the function.

name.description: The name of the related function.

description.description: How this function relates to the other function.

exampleUsages.description: Examples illustrating various usages of the function.

errors.description: Possible errors and reasons for these errors.

types.description: The return types of the function.

dependencies.description: Dependencies on other packages, modules, or functions.

todos.description: Todo items related to the function.
